items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, sensitive-looking skin comfortable.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a calm, comfortable skin barrier.

response.routine_note: Flushing that lingers, little bumps and gritty eyes are better assessed in person by a dermatologist (and an eye professional for the eye discomfort) than by anything we sell, so I have not suggested anything stronger. I removed the glycolic toner and the 5% benzoyl peroxide wash because strong exfoliating and drying actives are likely to sting and aggravate easily irritated, reddened skin; for now, cleanse gently and moisturize.
